name: cr0 #11
description:
The cr0’s black wings glide timelessly over the leaves bleeding red toward autumn. The creature seeks the southern horizon, following the flight path of its ancestors. Those eyes see summer’s fading glory as the rays of gold set the woods awash in oranges, browns, and scarlet hues. What endless possibilities will cr0 discover on its journey?

cr0 is the generative NFT mint on Async’s Music Blueprint by G3ARZ (J. Thorn). With 8 layers and 22 variables of visual art and music, only 20 collectibles exist in this genesis collection out of 2,300 possible works of art.

Experience the sad yet hopeful music signifying the end of one season and the beginning of another. What endless possibilities will you discover on your journey?
